news.title: Here’s the inflation breakdown for August 2026 — in one chart
news.description: Inflation remained stubbornly high in August, largely on the back of higher energy prices amid the Iran war, economists said.

news.title: Analysis: Hot inflation data sets up a Fed rate hike. What happens if Warsh wavers
news.description: August CPI data leaves Kevin Warsh to choose between acting on his inflation warnings or risking new doubts about his control of the central bank.
